description.text:
The Alchemist are masters in the dark arts of molecular mixology and demons in the kitchen. Their mixologists create every cocktail with an obsessive eye for detail, presented in vessels orchestrated to add a devilish dash of theatre, they bedazzle, bewitch and set the scene for everything they do.

Step inside where unexpected cocktail creations are fashioned right before your eyes. Savour a mouth-watering menu with delectable all-day dining in the brand's largest restaurant to date, spanning two floors inside and out. The venue boasts two outdoor terraces, providing great views of the Reuters Plaza estate.

Enjoy a flaming atmosphere, creative cocktails and devilishly delicious all-day dining that's become the Alchemist trademark - Theatre Served.
